messages.text: Happy to help with that. What's your order number, and the name or postcode ····?

Thanks Nathan, got it. That order has already shipped and was delivered on October 5, the Bitfortun BS-2, Yun Express tracking ····. So there's nothing left to cancel on it.

Can you tell me what's wrong? If the unit is faulty or arrived dead, I'll get you into our RMA process. If it's something else, tell me what happened and I'll see what I can do.

Understood. One thing so I point you the right way: is the miner faulty, or did you just change your mind about it?

If it's faulty, RMA covers it: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform and you get a return label. Note that overclocked or modified units aren't covered.

If it's a change of mind on a delivered unit, I'll get the team on it, but tell me which it is first.

Compris, Nathan. Sur une unité déjà livrée, c'est un retour: l'appareil revient à l'entrepôt, et un retour pour changement d'avis comporte des frais de restockage de 10%.

Avant d'aller là: si vous voulez autre chose dans la gamme, je peux regarder un échange, ou un crédit en boutique sur le montant. Ça vous coûte moins cher qu'un retour.

Vous préférez quoi, l'échange, le crédit, ou le remboursement?
